question: In a certain code language, 'CUT’ is coded as '52322' and 'CAN' is coded as '5316'. How will 'HIT' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'CUT’ is coded as '52322',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bf56be6dc714ccd3aed2d9d533a3ff185612911e1e0604106b84264793d3d5f.png] 

'CAN' is coded as '5316',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f47e74ff8d1b14711b0247ab05a50fff834a56e68f2953a09f6a2eb745635c19.png] 

Similarly, for '**HIT**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b096f3660cf39a31adb515ef82a7c73ac88209ee53ed2a8239b4eeb292ce8af0.png] 

So, 'HIT' is coded as '**101122**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
